name: kakei-golden-ratio
description: Netlify-ready static household budget ratio simulator

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/assets/css dist/assets/js dist/assets/images && sass src/scss/main.scss dist/assets/css/main.css --style=compressed --no-source-map && cp src/index.html dist/index.html && cp src/js/app.js dist/assets/js/app.js && cp -R src/assets/. dist/assets/
scripts.prepare:deploy: npm run compress:images && npm run build
